papers.title: The First EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis 2026: Cross-Domain Egocentric Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Yuqian Fu, Tianwen Qian, Yanjun Li, Yu Li, Kunyu Peng, Xu Zheng, Yongqin Xian, Alessio Tonioni, Yanwei Fu, Xiaoling Wang, Danda Paudel, Federico Tombari, Luc Van Gool, Leyi Wu, Yifan Zhao, Jinjie Zhang, Yinchuan Li, Yingcong Chen, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Wenbo Wang, Yupeng Hu, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie, Takuya Murakawa, Toru Tamaki, Yi Wen, Zhenglin Du, Zhengyang Li, Lingling Li, Licheng Jiao, Wenping Ma
papers.tags: visual question answering, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文注明全部作者的团队名称与机构信息在附录A中给出；通讯作者Yuqian Fu所属机构为King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, KAUST）
papers.intro: 本文介绍了在CVPR 2026第三届EgoVis Workshop上举办的首届EgoCross挑战赛——一个覆盖手术、工业、极限运动和动物视角四个非日常领域的跨域第一人称视频问答竞赛，详细报告了赛制设计、基线性能、排行榜结果与获奖方案，并公开了所有数据、基线和代码资源。

papers.title: FocusMem: Factorizing Content, Readout, and Trust in Latent GUI Memory
papers.authors: Zhuoran Zhang, Bowen Li, Jingcheng Ju, Yang Shi, Qixun Wang, Haotian Wang, Wei Chen, Tengjiao Wang
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science, Peking University; Key Lab of High Confidence Software Technologies, Peking University; Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: FocusMem提出了一种分解的潜在GUI记忆接口，通过角色感知内容基础、状态条件读取和块级信任门控，将记忆的内容形成、决策相关性和证据可信性解耦，在保持GUI策略冻结的情况下显著提升了五个GUI基准上的任务成功率。

papers.title: REZE: Recognition-Based Zero-Shot Extraction for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Boyang Li, Chenhui Gou, Jianfei Cai
papers.affiliations: Department of Data Science and AI, Monash University
papers.intro: REZE提出一种无需训练的零样本视频时间接地方法，将视频分割为短片段并用冻结的VLM逐片段打分，再通过外部确定性聚合算法将分数序列转换为单区间、多区间或高亮点检测结果，从而解耦识别与时间聚合，在多个基准上刷新了训练-free方法的SOTA。

papers.title: Predict, Then Retrieve: Cross-Instance Future-State Retrieval from Video Prefixes
papers.authors: Quynh Vo, Thong Nguyen, Vinh-Hien Do, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Anh-Tuan Luu
papers.affiliations: Centre for AI Research, VinUniversity; National University of Singapore（第一页同时列出两机构，作者具体归属未逐人标明）
papers.intro: 本文提出 Predictive State Retrieval (PSR) 任务和基准，并给出一个轻量级冻结编码器检索器 LFTR，通过天花板分解证明“预测未来状态”是核心可学习瓶颈，而“感知/检索”本身已接近可解。

papers.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering
papers.authors: Haotian Xia, Zilin Xiao, Junbo Zou, Vicente Ordonez, Hanjie Chen
papers.affiliations: 1Department of Computer Science, Rice University; 2College of Sciences, Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: DyLaR 提出一种“先感知、后按需推理”的潜在推理框架，将视频问答建模为“感知潜在变量（perception latents）进行视觉证据 grounding，再自适应决定是否追加推理潜在变量（reasoning latents）”的动态潜在响应，以不到20个token的生成长度在多个视频问答基准…

papers.title: Geo-Embed: Towards Unified Multimodal Embeddings for Urban Understanding
papers.authors: Jiapeng Li, Yong Li, Junjie Zhou, Fan Zhang, Yu Liu
papers.affiliations: 北京大学；北京邮电大学
papers.intro: 本文构建了面向城市理解的大规模多模态嵌入基准GeoMEB，并提出Geo-Embed统一嵌入模型，将异构地理空间查询-目标匹配统一为指令条件下的排序任务，在GeoMEB上相对最强基线取得15.3%的总体平均提升。

papers.title: TDVR: Joint Text Disambiguation and Viewpoint Reasoning for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
papers.authors: Qingxi Du, Junbo Wang, Yuke Li, Yining Zhu
papers.tags: point cloud, scene understanding, multimodal learning, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University（西北工业大学）
papers.intro: 论文提出TDVR，一个无需训练、基于多模态大模型的零样本3D视觉定位框架，通过联合文本消歧与视角推理，在ScanRefer和Sr3D数据集上显著超越现有零样本方法，甚至在部分指标上超过若干全监督方法。

papers.title: MissClick: Exploiting Digit-Serialized Coordinates to Attack GUI Grounding Models
papers.authors: Yu Ran, Wentao Zhao, Xin Zhang, Yi Pan
papers.affiliations: National University of Defense Technology
papers.intro: 论文提出MissClick，一种利用GUI定位模型坐标输出中数字序列的十进制位权结构、针对无目标和有目标攻击分别设计不同目标函数的白盒对抗攻击方法，显著提升了攻击成功率。

papers.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
papers.authors: Maximilian Dillitzer, Tin Stribor Sohn, Jason J. Corso, Michael Auerbach
papers.affiliations: University of Applied Science Esslingen; Karlsruhe Institute of Technology; Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG; University of Michigan
papers.intro: 本文通过系统实证研究，发现LLM和VLM对字母大小写具有类似于人类视觉显著性的内在注意力调制属性，大小写格式可作为零样本注意力引导机制，但注意力集中并不总是提升任务性能，且推理模型的思考阶段会缓冲这种表面形式的影响。

papers.title: MultiCompose: Multi-Concept Personalized Composition with Per-Subject Attribute Binding
papers.authors: Ruirui Zhang, Zhengkai Zhao, Pan Gao
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics（南京航空航天大学）
papers.intro: MultiCompose提出了一种无需联合训练的多主体个性化组合框架，通过语义保持正则化和两阶段推理（预融合+融合）实现逐主体属性绑定，并引入MSP-Bench基准联合评估身份保真度、属性绑定准确性和属性错位。

papers.title: Keep the Needle, Prune the Haystack: Defect-Preserving Token Pruning for Efficient Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Yanning Hou, Jingyuan Zhang, Xiaoyun Wang, Qixiang Ma, Sihang Zhou, Ke Xu
papers.tags: CLIP, image classification, edge deployment, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Anhui University, Hefei, China；National University of Defense Technology, Changsha, China
papers.intro: KeepAD 提出一种缺陷保留的渐进式 token 剪枝框架，在浅层采用覆盖保留选择、深层采用原型引导的自适应剪枝，通过稠密到稀疏自蒸馏训练，在保留不足20% token 的情况下将零样本异常检测的吞吐量提升最高 7.9 倍，且性能损失控制在可接受范围内。

papers.title: XiDepth: a Lightweight and Efficient Network for Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Elena Izzo, Riccardo Toniolo, Lamberto Ballan
papers.tags: depth estimation, edge deployment, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: University of Padova（具体为Department of Mathematics）
papers.intro: 本论文提出XiDepth，一种基于XiNet卷积块的高效轻量级自监督单目深度估计架构，仅用0.8M参数即在KITTI数据集上取得具有竞争力的性能，并在Raspberry Pi 4嵌入式平台上相比现有方法降低了40%的FLOPs和35%的能耗。

papers.title: Learning Biomechanically Plausible Human Motion from Sparse Radar Point Clouds
papers.authors: Jonas Leo Mueller, Markus Gambietz, Alexander Weiss, Daniel Krauss, Bjoern M. Eskofier
papers.affiliations: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (Department Artificial Intelligence in Biomedical Engineering, Chair of Autonomous Systems and Mechatronics), Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (Chair of AI-supported Therapy Decisions), Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML), Helmholtz Zentrum München (Institute of AI for Health)
papers.intro: 本文提出了首个将完整全身生物力学骨骼模型集成到基于稀疏雷达点云的人体姿态估计框架中的方法，通过可微分前向运动学、主体特定缩放和地面接触分类损失，实现了可解释且生物力学一致的人体运动恢复。

papers.title: From Bug Reports to Browser-Executable Procedures: An LLM-Driven Agent for Web GUI Bug Reproduction
papers.authors: Cunming Zhang, Yu Pei, Michail Papadakis
papers.affiliations: University of Luxembourg
papers.intro: 本文提出ReBug，一个上下文感知的LLM驱动代理系统，通过准备阶段重建缺失前提并生成高层复现计划，在执行阶段驱动真实浏览器进行状态感知的交互，最终依据报告推导的预期自动验证浏览器可观测状态，从而将自然语言Web GUI bug报告转化为可执行的浏览器复现过程。

papers.title: SlimVLM: Sensitivity-aware Dynamic Structured Pruning with Adaptive Visual Token Selection for Efficient Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yaozhi Wen, Jialong Guo, Zhenliang Ni, Han Shu, Xinghao Chen
papers.affiliations: Huawei Technologies
papers.intro: SlimVLM提出了一种面向视觉语言模型的结构化剪枝框架，通过自适应的视觉令牌选择策略和敏感性感知的动态剪枝比率调整机制，在显著压缩模型参数的同时维持甚至提升多模态任务性能。

papers.title: Test-Time Augmentation for Tabular-to-Image Classifiers under Distribution Shifts
papers.authors: Malena Loza, Felipe Grijalva, Eva Milara, Luis Bote-Curiel, Francisco J. Lara-Abelenda, David Chushig-Muzo
papers.affiliations: Colegio de Ciencias e Ingenierías, Universidad San Francisco de Quito (USFQ), Quito, Ecuador; Department of Signal Theory and Communications, Telematics and Computing Systems, Rey Juan Carlos University, Madrid, Spain; Faculty of Experimental Sciences, Universidad Francisco de Vitoria, Madrid, Spain
papers.intro: 本文通过系统评估25种测试时增强技术在6种表格到图像编码方法生成的图像上的效果，首次证实了TTA能提升分类器在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，其中组合式和光度式策略效果最佳，而频域变换策略会一致地损害性能。

papers.title: S$^3$-Diff: Structural Semantic Synergy Diffusion Model for High Fidelity Super Resolution of Pathological Images
papers.authors: Jiaming Liang, QiHui Han, Guangye Ou, Jiawen Liu, Haolin Chen, Xi Zhong, Jiazhou Chen, Xiaoqi Sheng, Hongmin Cai
papers.affiliations: 未明确（根据正文信息，作者分属华南理工大学、广州医科大学附属肿瘤医院、广东工业大学等机构；作者机构列表见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出S3-Diff，一种面向病理图像高保真超分辨率的"结构-语义协同扩散模型"，通过训练时的标本感知结构锚定（SSA）将SAM提取的预后感知组织先验注入DINOv3语义表示的适应性调优（SSFT），从而在推理时仅依赖LR输入构建复合控制流，引导潜在空间去噪过程在保持结构一致性的同时合成高质量纹理…

papers.title: IRIS: Visual-Semantic Binding for Forgery-Resistant Watermarking of Diffusion Images
papers.authors: Xiaoyan Feng, Zheng Gao, Tong Guan, Rui Bao, Bokang Zeng, Xiaoyu Li, Jiaojiao Jiang
papers.affiliations: Griffith University; University of New South Wales; Zhejiang University
papers.intro: IRIS提出一种训练无关的扩散图像生成期水印方案，从生成图像自身的CLIP视觉语义中派生一次性环形相位图案，在DDIM轨迹后期注入，使标记与图像语义绑定，从而抵御标记移植和伪造。

papers.title: Screenshots or Tools? Eliciting Tool Use and Managing Multimodal Context in Hybrid GUI-MCP Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Siqi Fan, Minghao Li, Xiaoqian Ma, Wenhui Tan, Xiusheng Huang, Juntong Wu, Liujie Zhang, Shuo Shang, Weihang Chen
papers.affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; AI Platform, Xiaohongshu Inc.; Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China; School of Electronic and Computer Engineering, Peking University
papers.intro: 论文诊断了混合 GUI-MCP 智能体中普遍存在的“工具采用差距”，并通过动作级和上下文级两个 RL 探针证明：工具决策行为可以被奖励轻易引导，但工具使用能力无法随之提升；相反，训练与推理观察规则的匹配可以在约一半输入成本下取得更高准确率。

papers.title: GUI-Lens: Coarse-to-Fine Cropping for GUI Grounding with General-Purpose VLMs
papers.authors: Zichuan Fu, Shirong Wang, Wenlin Zhang, Guojing Li, Yimin Deng, Jingtong Gao, Junjia Qi, Hanyu Yan, Yefeng Zheng, Xiaopeng Li, Wanyu Wang, Xian Wu, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.affiliations: City University of Hong Kong; Tencent Jarvis Lab; Westlake University
papers.intro: GUI-Lens 通过“坐标提示 + 由粗到细裁剪 + 视觉验证”三个模块，让通用 VLM 在做出最终点击前先进行多轮主动视觉观察，从而在不训练、不改写 VLM 权重的情况下显著提升 GUI grounding 的点击精度。
